angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) vs NFL pressure beyond pick + role, held out by class; day-3 film flag with a fixed rule and a frozen 2026 test
metric_name: Hoop G: hardest half-second of sideways lean on the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight (speed^2 / turn radius, in g), z within Combine year; construction (harder turn, 0.5 s) fixed in frozen_rule.json
headline_number: Held out (n=77): +2.3 pressures per 450 rushes per sd [0.9, 3.7] against the pick + role baseline (frozen for 2026 before Hoop G was examined); R2 gain 0.06 [-0.10, 0.20]. Ridge-shrunk full baseline +2.4 [1.0, 3.9]. Placebo: best of 11 shuffled measures (6 drills + 5 alternative Hoop G builds) reaches 2.3 in 5% of shuffles. Averaged-turn variant +1.5 [0.1, 2.9]. verify.py: +2.3 [0.8, 3.8] on the same 77.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 23 cand_1 (8.49). DS: headline baseline is now pick + role in every residual, the family screen, the day-3 test, the cards and verify.py; a ridge-shrunk full baseline (penalty chosen inside the training classes) is the single secondary; 5-row baseline table moved to the appendix with a plain-language line. New placebo shuffles the whole 11-column drill matrix (six drills plus five Hoop G constructions) within class; the averaged-turn build is the primary sensitivity; the disattenuated 3.5 is a secondary line only. Mediation (Hoop G -> NFL bend -> pressure, paths fitted out of class, class bootstrap) shows only 9% [-11, 38] runs through measured NFL bend. Negative control (run-snap tackle rate) reported honestly as not clean (-0.26 sd; -0.22 with weight). EPA filter traced: 1681 rusher rows / 135 credited -> 1655 plays; any-rusher pressure = 134 (round 22's first-row rule gave 132). Football: fixed Monday rule (pick 103+ and top third of class on Hoop G) flags 8.0 men a class (6-10); cost of a miss stated (false flag = a film session, 5 of 17; missed hit = 5.1 pressures / 2.7 EP a season, 9 cases); lede reconciled (NFL bend links to pressure, drill-to-NFL link weak, 9% mediated); tape-pull table with clip IDs, alignment, situation, get-off and the hardest lean for Solomon, Ingram-Dawkins and Harrell, labelled as not watched. Writeup: 'why now' sentence, two-sentence lede with the numbers stated once, why-hoop / why-day-3 split, jargon removed (partial Spearman, shrunk toward mean, fold-chosen, Holm/BH moved to the appendix), robustness as three one-line bullets, power and simulation moved to the appendix. Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt (overlaid hoop laps with 0.5 s ticks, a drill-vs-Sunday speed/radius panel for 78 rushers grafted from cand_2's speed-through-the-cut idea, speed-coloured NFL fans, glyph+colour titles, no boxed text); Fig 4 cards show a Hoop G class-rank strip instead of identical lap thumbnails, unclipped intervals, labels clear of the band, stats off the traces; Fig 3 legend carries the margin and the 11-measure chance line; Fig 2 moved to the appendix with direct line labels.
open_risks: No film was watched; the tape pull is clip IDs plus tracking facts, so the football judge's 'film-verified' request is only partly met
Negative control is not clean: Hoop G also predicts fewer run-snap tackles, and weight does not explain it, which weakens the 'bend' reading
Only 9% [-11, 38] of the slope runs through measured NFL bend; the mechanism is unproven
Placebo p = 0.05 for the best of 11; the R2 gain interval spans zero under every baseline
Day-3 forecast + Hoop G ties pick order (9 of 15 each) under the pick + role baseline; the case rests on the slope and the frozen 2026 test

Switching the headline baseline to pick + role changed several day-3 numbers from cand_1 (10 of 15 became 9 of 15); a judge may see that as a forking path, though pick + role was already the frozen 2026 forecast
